annotations.title: Coin brief: why it is moving

description: The one-call answer for ONE coin, with the news read (summary, mood, headlines) riding along, in the owner's order: summary (the answer first, the one record sentence at its end), you (the account's saved position on it, when there is one), backdrop (the market this fortnight and the headlines, each by outlet and date, and the market's state with its denominators), on_coin (dated facts, the change feed, situations), move (the move against its usual day and against BTC: usual_day_pct, move_pctile, vs_market), money_now (whales by window with lean at 60% and the hour-adjusted multiple, named accounts as labels, venues, forced closes, the fee, open positions, positioning, options), tracked_accounts (what the Hyperliquid accounts we track hold, both sides in dollars), levels (their real liquidation prices, nearest first; Pro), ahead (dated, each with the last times of that kind as counts a day and a week later), record (what followed the earlier times a day later and in week_later a week later, counts both ways, the coin's ordinary day beside them; present on a quiet coin too), case (points up and points down as sent, neither weighed), what_it_is, sources, gaps and unavailable (a section that could not be read, distinct from one read and empty). Answers "why is X moving" without a second call. view: brief (default), quick (price, funding, open interest only), funding (rate per exchange), crowding (0-100 crowding read, Pro), packets (SEVERAL coins in one call: pass `coins`, up to 12, and each comes back as one compact packet of price, whale dollars, forced closes, holding fee, open positions, forced-close levels, tracked accounts and its unusual time; with `coins` empty it is the coins unusual on the radar now. Use it in place of asking coin by coin).

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

coins.description: packets only: several coins in ONE call, a list or "BTC,ETH,SOL" (up to 12). Empty: the coins unusual on the radar now.

compact.description: true: one line of text instead of JSON.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

position_usd.description: Position size in USD, to price the funding cost.

question.description: The question to answer, as it was asked (e.g. "why is ETH down today"). `answer` is then written for it.

name: coin_brief

access_note.description: What this connection could not return.

available.description: False: no data; note says why.

truncated.description: Lists shortened to their top rows; trimmed has shown of all per list and note says it in words.
